ety.text: From электрозаво́д (elektrozavód, “electric factory”) + -ская (-skaja). From a project name and an electric trust. The newest, colloquial stress comes from the re-analyzed using the compound эле́ктро- (eléktro-) + заводска́я (zavodskája) with loose attachment of morphemes. Whereas the stress заводска́я (zavodskája) comes from the obsolete stress заво́дская (zavódskaja). Also, there can be no banalization process with a hypothetical re-analysis in the form of эле́ктро- (eléktro-) + заво́д (zavód) + -ская (-skaja), because the wordform заво́д (zavód) already has a final stress; compare with вел…
